389:t_1:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「We've been together a pretty long time now, you and me...」

389:t_1:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Ever since the Boss disappeared, you, $$メール$$, and I have charged ahead like a three-person, four-legged race, but it looks like I still don't understand you...」

389:t_1:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「...Lend me your strength, $$ガンレオン$$.」

389:t_1:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even $n is fighting like his life depends on it. If I, the master of his Smile, can't bring out your power, that's a joke...」

389:t_1:9.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...What is he doing over there?」

389:t_1:10.en:
$$メール$$
「Darling's been worrying about it all this time... He says he can't bring out $$ガンレオン$$'s real power...」

389:t_1:12.en:
$$メール$$
「He can fight in Magna Mode all the time now, so its combat strength is even higher than before, but...」

389:t_1:13.en:
$$メール$$
「Darling says $$ガンレオン$$'s power is nowhere near that little.」

389:t_1:14.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So basically, he can't draw out the $$スフィア$$'s power.」

389:t_1:16.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hmm... I wonder if it's because he ran into a huge power and it made him shrink back...」

389:t_1:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like $$ランド$$'s stuck in a rut.」

389:t_1:20.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If his fiancee makes a face like that, your beloved Darling's gonna be in trouble too.」

389:t_1:22.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Debtor! If you came to tease us, go away.」

389:t_1:23.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't be so cold, $$ティティ$$. I brought a plan to save $$ランド$$.」

389:t_1:24.en:
$$メール$$
「A plan!? Can $$クロウ$$ even come up with one!?」

389:t_1:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Believe it or not, I'm the guy who's watched $$ゼロ$$ of the $$黒の騎士団$$ and $$スメラギ$$ of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ up close.」

389:t_1:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「For starters, we begin by gathering the members.」

389:t_1:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「...What the heck is this, anyway? A group with a weirdly high average age.」

389:t_1:40.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$クロウ$$... Did all that debt give you a fever or something?」

389:t_1:41.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... I guess your head couldn't wrap itself around it.」

389:t_1:45.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The $$傷だらけの獅子$$ $$スフィア$$ shows its power by enduring pain...」

389:t_1:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And yet you, its Reactor, forget how to endure and let your anger fly right away. That's no good, is it?」

389:t_1:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry. With Mission Spring, I'll train you from scratch all over again.」

389:t_1:50.en:
$$クロウ$$
「When you press a spring down hard, it rebounds with a strong force, right? That's the image I had.」

389:t_1:51.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Also, it's a double meaning, so that $$ランド$$, who's lately been getting a foot in the door of old-man territory, can remember his youth... I mean, spring.」

389:t_1:53.en:
$$田中司令$$
「This is bad! $n's spirit is on the verge of dying again!」

389:t_1:54.en:
$$イアン$$
「He's probably just fed up, that's all...」

389:t_1:55.en:
$$オットー$$
「...I understand the point, but why did you go out of your way to gather us here?」

389:t_1:56.en:
$$オットー$$
「Even if it is break time, I am the captain of this ship.」

389:t_1:57.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I just figured that to make $$ランド$$ young again, I'd borrow the strength of our esteemed seniors.」

389:t_1:58.en:
$$弁慶$$
「So basically, it's old-man power, huh?」

389:t_1:59.en:
$$シャア$$
「Am I counted in that too...?」

389:t_1:60.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even me, who couldn't play father to $$クェス$$...?」

389:t_1:61.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Come on, Captain, Colonel, both of you. Just think of it as part of a squad leader's duties.」

389:t_1:62.en:
$$大杉$$
「That's right. It's nice to see some fresh faces for a change.」

389:t_1:63.en:
$$ランド$$
「So I've already got a foot in this crowd's camp, huh...」

389:t_1:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「See you, $$ランド$$. The rest is up to you.」

389:t_1:65.en:
$n
「If there's anything I can do, just call on me. I'll help.」

389:t_1:66.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No good, $n. Your youth won't be any use this time.」

389:t_1:67.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So that's how it is. I'm expecting results from you, $$ランド$$.」

389:t_1:68.en:
$$ランド$$
「What youth... Even he's got one foot in old-man territory, mentally.」

389:t_1:69.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...So, what do we do? Since it's called special training, should we run a mock battle?」

389:t_1:70.en:
$$シャア$$
「But then most of the members gathered here would have nothing to do.」

389:t_1:71.en:
$$オットー$$
「It's all strange to begin with... If we were gathered as veterans of life, why isn't Commander $$ブライト$$ called?」

389:t_1:72.en:
$$オットー$$
「That man fights stress every day, not only as a captain but as a fleet commander and as a father.」

389:t_1:73.en:
$$オットー$$
「Or is it that? Was I called because it was judged that the Commander is busy but I'm idle?」

389:t_1:75.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Honestly, that $$クロウ$$ fellow has no manners about these things.」

389:t_1:76.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「When I tried to add him to $$エコーズ$$ because he came from special forces, all he talked about was pay.」

389:t_1:77.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「No... it isn't only him. Young people always put their own profit first and make light of military discipline and a sense of duty.」

389:t_1:78.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... $$クロウ$$ and the young folks have their reasons too...」

389:t_1:79.en:
$$大杉$$
「No, no, Major $$コンロイ$$. That's not limited to $$エコーズ$$.」

389:t_1:81.en:
$$厚井$$
「$$アストナージ$$ and $$イアン$$ must feel it too.」

389:t_1:82.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Yes. You think they're waiting for orders, and then they go and do something outrageous.」

389:t_1:83.en:
$$イアン$$
「I know what you mean, $$アストナージ$$. Point it out and they complain, 'You don't get young people's sensibilities,' 'you old relic'...」

389:t_1:84.en:
$$カシオ$$
「On top of that, they say your feet stink, your hair's thin, you've got a gut... They barge right in on the things you're sensitive about with no restraint...」

389:t_1:85.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't think they said all that...」
